messages:
mira: Hey team, noticed a spike in ptls handshake latency and some transient 502/503s from eu-west svc-to-svc calls right after last night's control-plane cert rotation. Anyone else seeing this?

dan: I saw alerts too. Traces show long TLS handshake times (~800-1200ms) from a subset of pods in eu-west-2.

leo: @mira can you paste a sample trace id? I'll pull packet captures from the node.

mira: trace=trc-eu-1029-7a3f. Logs:
```
2026-02-16T03:12:21Z svc-a -> svc-b handshake_start
2026-02-16T03:12:22Z svc-a -> svc-b handshake_wait 980ms
2026-02-16T03:12:22Z svc-a -> svc-b fallback_to_tcp_after_timeout
2026-02-16T03:12:22Z svc-a -> svc-b 502 upstream
```

sam: Those fallbacks look like ptls client timed out waiting for OCSP/OCSP stapling response or cert chain assembly. We rotated intermediates last night, right?

dan: Yes, rotator job rolled a new intermediate across regions with a ~10m stagger. eu-west batch finished ~03:05 UTC. Some proxies might still fetch intermediates from the control plane while hitting KMS for unwrap.

leo: I pulled pcap for trc-eu-1029-7a3f: observed multiple retransmits to control-plane over 443 and a TLS Alert 40 (handshake_failure) from proxy side.

mira: @leo can you paste the exact ClientHello log?

leo: snippet: `ClientHello: TLS1.3, cipher_suites=[TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256], alpn=[ptls/1] extensions=[sni, supported_versions, signature_algorithms]` then server responded with `certificate_request` then stalled.

sam: Could be KMS unwrap latency causing cert serving glitch. After keystore rotation we saw a brief KMS throttling bump in control-plane logs. deploy-bot: any deploys touching proxy config last night?

deploy-bot: build 2026.02.15-255 applied: proxy image bump + rotator-runner v3. No config changes to handshake timeouts.

mira: Hypothesis: staggered intermediate rotation + transient KMS unwrap latency => control-plane served incomplete cert chain or delayed OCSP staple generation leading some ptls clients to exceed a short handshake timeout and fallback.

dan: Action items: 1) validate cert chain served by control-plane for a few affected proxies (openssl s_client -showcerts -servername svc-b). 2) check control-plane KMS unwrap latencies and retry errors during 03:00-03:20 UTC. 3) confirm client handshake timeout threshold (ptls default is 1s).

mira: I ran openssl against one affected proxy:
```
$ openssl s_client -connect proxy-eu-west-01:443 -servername svc-b -alpn ptls/1 -showcerts
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=svc-b.edge
 1 s:/CN=intermediate-2026-02-15
 2 s:/CN=redwood-root
---
OCSP response: no response sent
```

mira: chain looks complete but OCSP stapling missing. That matches the traces.

sam: Control-plane logs show KMS unwrap spikes at 02:58-03:04 with errors: `KMS: rate_limit_exceeded` then retries 2-3x. We need to correlate with rotator concurrency.

dan: For remediation: patch proxies to allow longer client handshake timeouts for ptls (temporary) and re-run rotator with lower concurrency. Also add a short circuit in control-plane to serve previously cached chain if KMS unwrap fails.

leo: Agreed. Also add an audit alert rule: if >1% of handshakes in region return OCSP missing within 15m of a rotation, raise high-priority.

mira: I'll open a quick PR for proxy timeout (10s) and a rotator concurrency change. PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/pulls/3127

sam: I'll file KMS tenant throttle escalation with cloud provider and increase retry-backoff in rotator.

dan: For postmortem, capture: timestamps of rotation, KMS throttle events, control-plane cache misses, and percentage of ptls fallbacks. We should also add a canary period where rotator runs only on 1-2 proxies and monitors OCSP stapling/handshake metrics.

mira: Sounds good. Quick checklist for immediate triage:
- [ ] patch proxy handshake timeout -> 10s (hotfix)
- [ ] rollback rotator concurrency to 1 for eu-west and re-run
- [ ] correlate KMS unwrap error rate (02:50-03:10)
- [ ] add audit alert for stapling missing near rotations

leo: I'll attach pcaps/traces to the incident ticket.

sam: Thx. Marking this P1 for now since customer-facing 502s were observed.

mira: I'll update the incident channel and follow up with compliance for any SLO breach notes. :eyes:
